Here’s a structured 12-week muscle gain program tailored to your 26-year-old vegan client with full-gym access. The plan emphasizes progressive hypertrophy, movement quality, and sufficient volume, with nutrition guidance to reliably hit 150 g plant protein/day. 

Overview
- Frequency: 4 days/week (Upper/Lower/Upper/Lower). Optional 5th day for accessories or conditioning if recovery is solid.
- Phases:
  - Weeks 1–4: Foundation Hypertrophy + Technique (volume base, progressive overload)
  - Weeks 5–8: Progressive Overload + Intensification (heavier compounds, strategic volume)
  - Weeks 9–11: Peak Hypertrophy (higher effort, slight exercise variation, intensifiers)
  - Week 12: Deload and Assess (recovery and testing readiness)
- Progression: Add 1–2.5 kg (upper) or 2.5–5 kg (lower) weekly if reps at RIR target are met. If not, keep load and aim to add reps next week.
- Effort targets: RIR = reps in reserve
  - Weeks 1–2: RIR 2–3
  - Weeks 3–6: RIR 1–2
  - Weeks 7–11: RIR 0–1 (last set often near failure on safe lifts)
  - Week 12 (deload): RIR 3–4
- Tempo: 2–3 second controlled eccentrics on primary lifts, 1–2 second pause in lengthened position where noted.
- Rest: 2–3 min compounds, 60–90 s accessories, 30–45 s isolation.

Weekly Split Template
- Day 1: Upper A (horizontal push/pull focus)
- Day 2: Lower A (squat pattern + hinge accessory)
- Day 3: Rest or light cardio/mobility
- Day 4: Upper B (vertical push/pull focus)
- Day 5: Lower B (hinge pattern + squat accessory)
- Day 6–7: Rest; optional low-intensity cardio/mobility on one day

Warm-Up (each session)
- 5–8 min light cyc/cardio
- Dynamic mobility (T-spine extensions, hip openers, ankle rocks)
- 2–3 ramp-up sets for the first two compounds (40%, 60–70%, 80–85% of working load)

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 – Foundation Hypertrophy and Technique
Goal: Establish volume, refine technique, build mind-muscle connection, find starting loads.

Week 1–2 (RIR 2–3)
Upper A
- Barbell flat bench press 4x6–8
- One-arm dumbbell row 4x8–10/side
- Incline DB press 3x8–10
- Chest-supported rear-delt raise 3x12–15
- Cable fly (slight decline) 2x12–15
- Cable rope triceps pressdown 3x10–12
- DB hammer curl 3x10–12

Lower A
- Back squat (high-bar) 4x6–8
- Romanian deadlift 4x6–8
- Bulgarian split squat 3x8–10/leg
- Leg curl (seated) 3x10–12
- Leg press calf raise 4x10–12 with 2s pause stretch
- Cable woodchop or dead bug 3x10–12/side

Upper B
- Overhead press (barbell or DB) 4x6–8
- Lat pulldown (neutral grip) 4x8–10
- Seated cable row (wide neutral) 3x8–10
- DB lateral raise 4x12–15 (last set to near-failure)
- Machine chest press 3x8–10
- EZ-bar curl 3x10–12
- Overhead cable triceps extension 3x10–12

Lower B
- Trap bar deadlift 4x5–6
- Front squat 4x6–8

- Ab wheel rollout 3x8–12

Week 3–4 (RIR 1–2, add load if rep targets met)
- Keep exercises; progress reps or load.
- Add one set to the first two compounds on each day (e.g., Bench 5 sets, Squat 5 sets).

Here’s the complete 12-week muscle-gain program for your 26-year-old vegan client, integrating all adjustments: 4-day Upper/Lower split, added cardio, high-protein vegan nutrition (150 g/day), a weekly “cheat meal,” and Phase 3 intensity push. Written week-by-week with clear structure, progression, and recovery.

Structure overview
- Split: 4 days/week (Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B). Optional light cardio/mobility on rest days.
- Phases:
  - Weeks 1–4: Foundation Hypertrophy + Technique
  - Weeks 5–8: Progressive Overload + Intensification
  - Weeks 9–11: Peak Hypertrophy with intensifiers (controlled)
  - Week 12: Deload and assessment
- Progression: Add 1–2.5 kg to upper lifts or 2.5–5 kg to lower lifts weekly if you hit the top of the rep range at target RIR. Otherwise add reps within the range.
- Effort (RIR):
  - Weeks 1–2: 2–3 RIR
  - Weeks 3–6: 1–2 RIR
  - Weeks 7–11: 0–1 RIR on last set of key lifts (safer lifts get intensifiers)
  - Week 12: 3–4 RIR
- Rest: 2–3 min compounds; 60–90 s accessories; 30–45 s isolations.
- Tempo: Controlled 2–3 s eccentrics on compounds; pauses where noted.

Weekly split template
- Day 1: Upper A (horizontal push/pull focus)
- Day 2: Lower A (squat pattern + hinge accessory)
- Day 3: Rest or mobility/cardio (see cardio plan)
- Day 4: Upper B (vertical push/pull focus)
- Day 5: Lower B (hinge pattern + squat accessory)
- Day 6–7: Rest; one day has longer Zone 2 cardio

Warm-up each session
- 5–8 min light cyc/cardio, dynamic mobility (T-spine, hips, ankles), 2–3 ramp-up sets for the first two compound lifts.

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 – Foundation Hypertrophy and Technique
Goal: Build volume base, refine technique, establish starting loads.

Week 1–2 (RIR 2–3)
Upper A
- Barbell bench press 4x6–8
- One-arm DB row 4x8–10/side
- Incline DB press 3x8–10
- Chest-supported rear-delt raise 3x12–15
- Cable fly (slight decline) 2x12–15
- Cable rope triceps pressdown 3x10–12
- DB hammer curl 3x10–12

Lower A
- Back squat (high-bar) 4x6–8
- Romanian deadlift 4x6–8
- Bulgarian split squat 3x8–10/leg
- Seated ham curl 3x10–12
- Leg press calf raise 4x10–12 (2 s stretch at bottom)
- Dead bug or cable woodchop 3x10–12/side

Upper B
- Overhead press (barbell or DB) 4x6–8
- Lat pulldown (neutral grip) 4x8–10
- Seated cable row (wide neutral) 3x8–10
- DB lateral raise 4x12–15 (last set near-failure but still 1–2 RIR)
- Machine chest press 3x8–10
- EZ-bar curl 3x10–12
- Overhead cable triceps extension 3x10–12

Lower B
- Trap bar deadlift 4x5–6
- Front squat 4x6–8
- Hip thrust 3x8–10 (2 s hold at top)
- Reverse lunge 3x8–10/leg
- Ab wheel rollout 3x8–12
- Seated calf raise 4x12–15

Week 3–4 (RIR 1–2; small load increase if rep tops hit)
- Keep exercises; add one set to the first two compounds each day (e.g., Bench to 5 sets; Squat to 5 sets).
- Optional Week 4: One drop set on a single isolation per session.

Cardio Weeks 1–4
- Week 1–2: Post Upper days 12–15 min Zone 2; Weekend 25–30 min Zone 2. Total ~50–60 min.
- Week 3–4: Post Upper days 15–20 min Zone 2; Weekend 30–35 min. Optional HIIT once: 6–8 x 30 s hard/90 s easy on bike or 10–12 min tempo if recovery is good. Total 70–95 min.

Phase 2: Weeks 5–8 – Progressive Overload and Intensification
Goal: Heavier compounds, maintain/increase accessory volume, push close to failure while managing fatigue.

Week 5–6 (RIR 1–2)
Upper A
- Barbell bench press 5x5–6
- Chest-supported T-bar row 4x6–8
- Incline DB press 3x8–10
- Cable fly (mid) 2x12–15
- Rear-delt cable cross 3x12–15
- Dips (assisted if needed) 3x6–10
- Alternating DB curl 3x10–12

Lower A
- Back squat 5x5–6
- RDL 4x6–8
- Hack squat or leg press 3x8–10
- Lying or seated ham curl 3x10–12
- Standing calf raise 4x8–10 heavy
- Weighted plank 3x30–45 s

Upper B
- Overhead press 5x5–6
- Weighted pull-up or pulldown 4x6–8
- One-arm cable row 3x8–10/side
- DB lateral raise 4x10–15 (last set drop set optional)
- Machine incline press 3x8–10
- Cable curl (EZ handle) 3x10–12
- Cable overhead triceps extension 3x10–12

Lower B
- Deadlift (conventional or sumo) 5x3–5
- Front squat 4x5–6
- Hip thrust 4x6–8 (2 s hold)
- Walking lunge 3x10/leg
- Ab wheel 3x10–12
- Seated calf raise 4x12–15

Week 7–8 (push effort; last set compounds RIR 0–1 if form solid)
- Keep structure; small load increases.
- Add one intensifier per session on a safe movement (e.g., rest-pause on ham curl or machine press; cluster 4+4+4 on hip thrust once in Week 8).
- If reps drop >2 across sets, hold load or remove one accessory set.

Cardio Weeks 5–8
- Week 5–6: Post Upper days 15–20 min Zone 2; Weekend 35–40 min Zone 2. Optional HIIT only if you trim one post-Upper to 10–12 min. Total 80–100 min.
- Week 7–8: Hard lifting weeks—cap post Upper to 12–15 min; Weekend 30–40 min. Skip HIIT unless recovery is excellent. Total 55–80 min.

Phase 3: Weeks 9–11 – Peak Hypertrophy (intensity pushed)
Global Phase 3 rules
- Compounds: Top set at RIR 0–1 then 1–2 back-offs (−8–12%). No harsh intensifiers on heavy barbell squats/deads.
- Accessories: Last set RIR 0–1 with a single intensifier (rest-pause, drop, tempo/partials).
- Don’t exceed two intensifiers in any single session.

Week 9
Upper A
- DB flat press: 1x6–8 top set (RIR 0–1) + 2x8–10 back-offs (−8–10%)
- Chest-supported row: 3–4x8–10; last set rest-pause 10–12 total reps (e.g., 9+3)
- Smith incline press: 3x6–8; last set drop 20–25% for 8–10
- Cable fly low-to-high: 3x12–15 + 2–3 lengthened partials
- Rear-delt machine: 3x12–15; standard
- Cross-body cable triceps: 3x10–12; 2–3 s eccentric

Lower A
- Safety-bar squat: 1x5–6 top set (RIR 0–1) + 2x6–8 back-offs
- RDL: 3–4x6–8; 2–3 s eccentrics
- Leg press: 3x10–12; last set rest-pause 12–15 total
- Seated ham curl: 3x10–12; 1–2 s peak squeeze
- Standing calf raise: 4x8–10; last set 10–15 partials after failure
- Cable anti-rotation press: 3x10–12/side

Upper B
- Push press or strict OHP: 1x4–6 top set + 2x6–8 back-offs
- Weighted pull-up/pulldown: 4x6–8; last set rest-pause 10–12 total
- Low cable row: 3x8–10; standard
- Lateral raise mechanical drop set: 3 rounds (full ROM → partials)
- Pec deck or cable fly: 3x10–12; standard
- EZ curl: 3x8–10; last set drop 20% for 6–8 more
- Rope pressdown: 3x10–12; standard

Lower B
- Deadlift (conv/sumo): 4x3–5 (RIR 1; final set may be RIR 0 if technique pristine)
- Front squat or hack squat: 3–4x5–6; last set RIR 0–1
- Hip thrust: 3–4x6–8 (2 s hold); last set rest-pause 10–12 total
- Reverse lunge (deficit): 3x8/leg; controlled
- Hanging leg raise: 3x10–12
- Seated calf raise: 4x12–15; optional 30 s loaded stretch after last set

Week 10 (keep Week 9 structure; add tempo emphasis)
- Add 3 s eccentrics on one accessory per session (e.g., cable fly, ham curl, lateral raise, reverse lunge).
- Keep all chosen intensifiers from Week 9.

Week 11 (minor exercise swaps to refresh stimulus; keep intensity)
Upper A
- Swap DB flat → Machine chest press 4x6–10 (last set drop)
- Keep chest-supported row with last-set RP
- Swap fly angle; keep rear-delt machine; triceps with 3 s eccentrics

Lower A
- Keep SSB squat; optionally swap RDL → good morning (lighter) if fatigue high
- Leg press RP last set; ham curl drop last set; calves partials finisher

Upper B
- Swap pulldown grip (supinated/neutral) and keep last-set RP
- Keep lateral raise mechanical drop set; curls drop last set; pressdown with lengthened partials (10–12)

Lower B
- Keep deadlift straight sets; swap front squat → hack squat if available; hip thrust RP last set; seated calves finish with 30–40 s loaded stretch

Cardio Weeks 9–11
- Post Upper days: 15–20 min Zone 2
- Weekend: 35–45 min Zone 2 steady
- Optional every other week: 4–5 x 2 min hard (RPE 8) / 2–3 min easy on bike/rower—skip if taking multiple compounds to true 0 RIR that week
- Total: 90–140 min/week. Keep HIIT at least 24 h away from Lower A/B.

Week 12 – Deload and Assess
- Volume −40–50%; load −5–10%; RIR 3–4
- Compounds: 3x5 at ~75–80% of Week 11 working loads
- Accessories: 2x10–12 easy; no intensifiers
- Cardio: 2–3 x 20–30 min easy Zone 2; no HIIT
- Collect: Bodyweight trend, measurements, progress photos, performance notes, joint/energy check; plan next mesocycle

Cardio placement rules (all phases)
- Place Zone 2 after Upper days and on weekend. Keep HIIT/tempo at least 24 h from Lower A/B.
- If legs feel heavy pre-squat/dead, switch prior cardio to bike/upper-body erg and cap at <15 min.

Weekly “cheat meal” integration
- 1 flexible meal/week (not a day), ideally post Lower B (Friday dinner).
- Keep daily protein ≥150 g. Pair indulgent choices with a protein source or shake.
- If meal adds ~500–800 kcal above plan, trim 100–150 kcal from 2–4 other days or add 15–20 min Zone 2 once that week.
- Post-meal 10–20 min walk; expect temporary water weight.

Vegan nutrition to hit 150 g protein/day
- Calories: Start ~200–300 kcal above maintenance (many active women 2,200–2,600 kcal/day). Adjust for +0.25–0.5 lb/week gain.
- Protein: 150 g/day minimum from plants only.
- Carbs: 2.5–4 g/kg; increase on heavy days.
- Fats: 0.6–0.8 g/kg.
- Protein quality strategy:
  - Base around soy (tofu, tempeh, edamame), seitan, pea/rice blends, lentil pasta, TVP.
  - Aim 30–40 g protein per meal, targeting ≥2–3 g leucine.
- Peri-workout:
  - Pre (1–2 h): 20–30 g protein + 30–60 g carbs + 400–600 ml fluid.
  - Intra (if >75 min): 20–30 g carbs + electrolytes.
  - Post (0–2 h): 30–40 g plant protein + 60–90 g carbs.
- Supplements (vegan):
  - Creatine monohydrate 3–5 g/day
  - Beta-alanine 3.2–6.4 g/day split
  - Algae DHA/EPA 250–500 mg/day
  - Vitamin B12 250 mcg/day or 1,000 mcg/week; Vitamin D3 per labs (1,000–2,000 IU common)
  - Monitor iron, iodine, zinc as needed

High-protein breakfast ideas (30–45 g)
- Tofu scramble + toast; Tempeh burrito; Protein smoothie (pea/rice or soy isolate + soy milk); Soy yogurt + protein parfait; Protein oats.

Post-workout meal ideas (30–45 g protein + carbs)
- Tofu rice stir-fry; Tempeh quinoa bowl; Seitan fajita tacos (+beans); Lentil pasta + TVP marinara; Sushi bowl with tofu + edamame; Protein shake + bagel if appetite is low.

Coaching checkpoints by week
- Week 1: Find starting loads, RIR honesty, nail 150 g protein/day.
- Week 2: Small load bumps; monitor DOMS and recovery.
- Week 3: Add sets to main lifts; introduce one isolation drop set.
- Week 4: Form PRs; technique videos for squat/bench/dead/OHP/hip thrust.
- Week 5: Heavier 5–6 rep compounds; keep accessories 8–12; creatine consistent.
- Week 6: Slight load bump; one rest-pause on machine press or ham curl if recovered.
- Week 7: Last set compounds near-failure; reduce HIIT; ensure sleep/calories adequate.
- Week 8: Chase small PRs; optional cluster on hip thrust; joints check.
- Week 9: Introduce Phase 3 intensifiers; top-set + back-offs on compounds.
- Week 10: Add tempo emphasis on one accessory per session; nutrition carbs up on hard days.
- Week 11: Minor exercise swaps; maintain intensity; don’t stack >2 intensifiers/session.
- Week 12: Deload; assess progress; plan next meso.

Simple weekly calendar example
- Mon Upper A: Lift + 15–20 min Zone 2 (bike)
- Tue Lower A: Lift only
- Wed: Rest or optional HIIT/tempo (only in weeks allowing it); mobility walk 20–30 min
- Thu Upper B: Lift + 15–20 min Zone 2 (elliptical)
- Fri Lower B: Lift only; evening cheat meal
- Sat/Sun: 30–45 min Zone 2 steady (one day); one full rest day

Notes on load selection
- Start conservative in Weeks 1–2 to truly meet RIR targets. Progress by load first, then reps.
- If recovery flags: drop 2–4 sets/week total or remove one intensifier the next session.

Here’s the complete 12-week muscle-gain program for your 26-year-old vegan client, integrating all adjustments: 4-day Upper/Lower split, added cardio, high-protein vegan nutrition (150 g/day), a weekly “cheat meal,” and Phase 3 intensity push. Written week-by-week with clear structure, progression, and recovery.

Structure overview
- Split: 4 days/week (Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B). Optional light cardio/mobility on rest days.
- Phases:
  - Weeks 1–4: Foundation Hypertrophy + Technique
  - Weeks 5–8: Progressive Overload + Intensification
  - Weeks 9–11: Peak Hypertrophy with intensifiers (controlled)
  - Week 12: Deload and assessment
- Progression: Add 1–2.5 kg to upper lifts or 2.5–5 kg to lower lifts weekly if you hit the top of the rep range at target RIR. Otherwise add reps within the range.
- Effort (RIR):
  - Weeks 1–2: 2–3 RIR
  - Weeks 3–6: 1–2 RIR
  - Weeks 7–11: 0–1 RIR on last set of key lifts (safer lifts get intensifiers)
  - Week 12: 3–4 RIR
- Rest: 2–3 min compounds; 60–90 s accessories; 30–45 s isolations.
- Tempo: Controlled 2–3 s eccentrics on compounds; pauses where noted.

Weekly split template
- Day 1: Upper A (horizontal push/pull focus)
- Day 2: Lower A (squat pattern + hinge accessory)
- Day 3: Rest or mobility/cardio (see cardio plan)
- Day 4: Upper B (vertical push/pull focus)
- Day 5: Lower B (hinge pattern + squat accessory)
- Day 6–7: Rest; one day has longer Zone 2 cardio

Warm-up each session
- 5–8 min light cyc/cardio, dynamic mobility (T-spine, hips, ankles), 2–3 ramp-up sets for the first two compound lifts.

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 – Foundation Hypertrophy and Technique
Goal: Build volume base, refine technique, establish starting loads.

Week 1–2 (RIR 2–3)
Upper A
- Barbell bench press 4x6–8
- One-arm DB row 4x8–10/side
- Incline DB press 3x8–10
- Chest-supported rear-delt raise 3x12–15
- Cable fly (slight decline) 2x12–15
- Cable rope triceps pressdown 3x10–12
- DB hammer curl 3x10–12

Lower A
- Back squat (high-bar) 4x6–8
- Romanian deadlift 4x6–8
- Bulgarian split squat 3x8–10/leg
- Seated ham curl 3x10–12
- Leg press calf raise 4x10–12 (2 s stretch at bottom)
- Dead bug or cable woodchop 3x10–12/side

Upper B
- Overhead press (barbell or DB) 4x6–8
- Lat pulldown (neutral grip) 4x8–10
- Seated cable row (wide neutral) 3x8–10
- DB lateral raise 4x12–15 (last set near-failure but still 1–2 RIR)
- Machine chest press 3x8–10
- EZ-bar curl 3x10–12
- Overhead cable triceps extension 3x10–12

Lower B
- Trap bar deadlift 4x5–6
- Front squat 4x6–8
- Hip thrust 3x8–10 (2 s hold at top)
- Reverse lunge 3x8–10/leg
- Ab wheel rollout 3x8–12
- Seated calf raise 4x12–15

Week 3–4 (RIR 1–2; small load increase if rep tops hit)
- Keep exercises; add one set to the first two compounds each day (e.g., Bench to 5 sets; Squat to 5 sets).
- Optional Week 4: One drop set on a single isolation per session.

Cardio Weeks 1–4
- Week 1–2: Post Upper days 12–15 min Zone 2; Weekend 25–30 min Zone 2. Total ~50–60 min.
- Week 3–4: Post Upper days 15–20 min Zone 2; Weekend 30–35 min. Optional HIIT once: 6–8 x 30 s hard/90 s easy on bike or 10–12 min tempo if recovery is good. Total 70–95 min.

Phase 2: Weeks 5–8 – Progressive Overload and Intensification
Goal: Heavier compounds, maintain/increase accessory volume, push close to failure while managing fatigue.

Week 5–6 (RIR 1–2)
Upper A
- Barbell bench press 5x5–6
- Chest-supported T-bar row 4x6–8
- Incline DB press 3x8–10
- Cable fly (mid) 2x12–15
- Rear-delt cable cross 3x12–15
- Dips (assisted if needed) 3x6–10
- Alternating DB curl 3x10–12

Lower A
- Back squat 5x5–6
- RDL 4x6–8
- Hack squat or leg press 3x8–10
- Lying or seated ham curl 3x10–12
- Standing calf raise 4x8–10 heavy
- Weighted plank 3x30–45 s

Upper B
- Overhead press 5x5–6
- Weighted pull-up or pulldown 4x6–8
- One-arm cable row 3x8–10/side
- DB lateral raise 4x10–15 (last set drop set optional)
- Machine incline press 3x8–10
- Cable curl (EZ handle) 3x10–12
- Cable overhead triceps extension 3x10–12

Lower B
- Deadlift (conventional or sumo) 5x3–5
- Front squat 4x5–6
- Hip thrust 4x6–8 (2 s hold)
- Walking lunge 3x10/leg
- Ab wheel 3x10–12
- Seated calf raise 4x12–15

Week 7–8 (push effort; last set compounds RIR 0–1 if form solid)
- Keep structure; small load increases.
- Add one intensifier per session on a safe movement (e.g., rest-pause on ham curl or machine press; cluster 4+4+4 on hip thrust once in Week 8).
- If reps drop >2 across sets, hold load or remove one accessory set.

Cardio Weeks 5–8
- Week 5–6: Post Upper days 15–20 min Zone 2; Weekend 35–40 min Zone 2. Optional HIIT only if you trim one post-Upper to 10–12 min. Total 80–100 min.
- Week 7–8: Hard lifting weeks—cap post Upper to 12–15 min; Weekend 30–40 min. Skip HIIT unless recovery is excellent. Total 55–80 min.

Phase 3: Weeks 9–11 – Peak Hypertrophy (intensity pushed)
Global Phase 3 rules
- Compounds: Top set at RIR 0–1 then 1–2 back-offs (−8–12%). No harsh intensifiers on heavy barbell squats/deads.
- Accessories: Last set RIR 0–1 with a single intensifier (rest-pause, drop, tempo/partials).
- Don’t exceed two intensifiers in any single session.

Week 9
Upper A
- DB flat press: 1x6–8 top set (RIR 0–1) + 2x8–10 back-offs (−8–10%)
- Chest-supported row: 3–4x8–10; last set rest-pause 10–12 total reps (e.g., 9+3)
- Smith incline press: 3x6–8; last set drop 20–25% for 8–10
- Cable fly low-to-high: 3x12–15 + 2–3 lengthened partials
- Rear-delt machine: 3x12–15; standard
- Cross-body cable triceps: 3x10–12; 2–3 s eccentric

Lower A

Vegan nutrition to hit 150 g protein/day
- Calories: Start ~200–300 kcal above maintenance (many active women 2,200–2,600 kcal/day). Adjust for +0.25–0.5 lb/week gain.
- Protein: 150 g/day minimum from plants only.
- Carbs: 2.5–4 g/kg; increase on heavy days.
- Fats: 0.6–0.8 g/kg.
- Protein quality strategy:
  - Base around soy (tofu, tempeh, edamame), seitan, pea/rice blends, lentil pasta, TVP.
  - Aim 30–40 g protein per meal, targeting ≥2–3 g leucine.
- Peri-workout:
  - Pre (1–2 h): 20–30 g protein + 30–60 g carbs + 400–600 ml fluid.
  - Intra (if >75 min): 20–30 g carbs + electrolytes.
  - Post (0–2 h): 30–40 g plant protein + 60–90 g carbs.
- Supplements (vegan):
  - Creatine monohydrate 3–5 g/day
  - Beta-alanine 3.2–6.4 g/day split
  - Algae DHA/EPA 250–500 mg/day
  - Vitamin B12 250 mcg/day or 1,000 mcg/week; Vitamin D3 per labs (1,000–2,000 IU common)
  - Monitor iron, iodine, zinc as needed
